root_cause: Transformers 5.14 probed optional processor_config.json on the Hugging Face Hub when the model was addressed only by mutable model ID. A restricted network interrupted fallback even though the frozen snapshot contained preprocessor_config.json and model weights.
fix: Pin the immutable CED revision and prefer model-ID loading with local_files_only=true whenever that exact snapshot is present; retain pinned online fallback only for a fresh installation.
